optimizedDescription.value: Named organizational unit for specs/code/schemas/ownership; every spec belongs to exactly one workspace.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace

## Rules
- Unique name in `specd.yaml`; `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`. Reserved: `default` (mandatory local), `root` (project-global graph).
- Props: `specs` (always); `codeRoot` (required non-default; default ws → project root); `schemas`; `ownership` (default `owned` / non-default `readOnly`); `prefix`; `contextIncludeSpecs`/`contextExcludeSpecs`. Paths relative to `specd.yaml` dir.
- `isExternal` inferred when specs path outside repo root — never declared.
- Ownership: `owned`/`shared`/`readOnly`. `readOnly` rejects: change scope add, ArchiveChange, SpecRepository.save/saveMetadata → `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` (state blocked op + why; MUST NOT suggest remediation). Reads allowed. `shared`≡`owned` for writes.
- `prefix` prepended to capability paths; not unique ID. Invalid → `ConfigValidationError`.
- Spec IDs `workspace:capabilityPath`; bare = `default:`. Internally always qualified.
- Active workspaces = change `specIds` via `parseSpecId()`/`workspaces` getter — not persisted.
- Primary workspace = first in `change.workspaces` (archive template / default metadata attribution).
- Port-per-workspace: `ReadonlyMap<string, RepositoryInstance>`.
- Workspace context patterns apply only when active; bare qualifier = this ws; excludes never apply to dependsOn-reached specs; evaluated after project patterns.
- Cross-ws refs OK; unknown ws: config validate error; runtime context warn+skip.
- Change artifacts always include workspace segment: `specs/<ws>/...`, `deltas/<ws>/...`.
- Consuming project's `specd.yaml` sole SoT — never read external repo's config.

## Constraints
- Every project declares default workspace.
- Name regex enforced; `codeRoot` required for non-default.
- `isExternal` inferred; spec IDs always qualified internally.
- Empty `specIds` → empty `workspaces`.
- External configs never read.
- ReadOnly blocks all writes; errors must not suggest remediation.
